import html # Example template for displaying a blog post. The placeholders `{title}` and `{body}` # will be replaced by the sanitized values. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def render_blog_post(title: str, body: str) -> str: """ Return a safe HTML representation of a user‑generated blog post. Parameters ---------- title : str The raw title supplied by the user. body : str The raw body content supplied by the user. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized title and body inserted into ``BLOG_FORMAT``. Notes ----- * The function uses :func:`html.escape` to neutralise any HTML or JavaScript that might be injected by a malicious user. This protects against CWE‑74 (Improper Neutralisation of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component). * No additional HTML tags are added to the user content, so the output remains safe for direct inclusion in a web page. """ # Sanitize user input to prevent injection attacks safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=True) # Format the sanitized content into the template return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
